title: Tablao Flamenco Cordobes Show & Drink or Gourmet Dinner
description: Experience Barcelona's most prestigious flamenco institution on Las Ramblas. Founded in 1970 and designed by Bourbon restaurateurs with cave acoustics, showcasing Spain's elite award-winning bailaores, guitarists, and singers.
includes: Admission to Tablao Cordobes live show
Drink of choice (Sangria, Wine, Cava or Soft Drink)
imageAlt: Passionate flamenco dancer performing with red dress and dramatic stage lighting at Tablao Cordobes Barcelona
bestFor: Travelers seeking Barcelona's highest caliber authentic flamenco masters

title: Teatro City Hall Historic Flamenco Show with Drink
description: Watch world-class flamenco artists perform inside the historic 19th-century Teatro City Hall in central Barcelona. Features dramatic bulerías, soleás, and virtuosic Spanish guitar solos with exceptional theater acoustics.
includes: Reserved seat at Teatro City Hall
Glass of Spanish wine, sangria or beer
imageAlt: Spanish flamenco guitarist and dancer performing live on stage at Teatro City Hall Barcelona
bestFor: First-time visitors wanting an authentic high-energy theater performance at great value

title: Los Tarantos Flamenco Show in Plaça Reial
description: Feel the raw emotion of authentic flamenco at Barcelona's oldest tablao, operating in the Gothic Quarter's Plaça Reial since 1963. Fast-paced, passionate 40-minute sets featuring rising stars of Spanish flamenco.
includes: Intimate standing & seated Gothic Quarter venue
imageAlt: Live flamenco dance performance at Los Tarantos in Plaça Reial Gothic Quarter Barcelona
bestFor: Budget-conscious travelers and quick evening cultural outings in the Gothic Quarter

title: Tablao de Carmen Flamenco Show with Tapas & Dinner
description: Tribute to the legendary Carmen Amaya located inside Poble Espanyol on Montjuïc hill. Includes free admission to the open-air architectural museum and an authentic multi-course Andalusian dinner or tapas tasting with wine during the show.
includes: 3-course Spanish dinner or traditional tapas tasting
Free entry to Poble Espanyol museum from 4:00 PM
Wine, sangria, cava & mineral water included
imageAlt: Spanish tapas, wine and authentic flamenco dinner show at Tablao de Carmen Barcelona
bestFor: Couples and food lovers wanting a complete dinner, wine, and cultural evening

title: Palau Dalmases Intimate Palace Flamenco with Drink
description: Immerse yourself in centuries of Catalan nobility inside a 17th-century Baroque palace in El Born. Candlelit stone arches, close-up acoustics, and an emotive flamenco quartet comprising dancer, singer, guitarist, and cajón.
includes: Complimentary glass of wine, cava or beer
imageAlt: Candlelight atmosphere in historic Baroque palace courtyard in Barcelona El Born
bestFor: Romance and heritage lovers wanting an intimate historic palace setting
